The chemical formula for water is derived from its constituent elements: hydrogen and oxygen. Specifically, one molecule of water consists of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.

The symbols for these elements are H (hydrogen) and O (oxygen). Therefore, the formula is written as H₂O.

<answer>H₂O</answer>
